notes: Quality caps are development-reference p95 plus max(10 percent, declared absolute tolerance), per task; they are engineering comparison caps, not validated real-robot safety limits.
Deadline starts at control handoff and ends after withdrawal to the same declared clearance and independent stable acceptance. It excludes simulator startup and includes in-episode retry time.
Failures and missing quality observations never count as qualified success. A safely triggered protective stop is a failed attempt, not automatically a physical safety violation.
Final evidence requires three training seeds evaluated separately on the same frozen 100 cases per task; do not pool repeated cases across seeds as independent trials.
Current and historical holdouts already inspected are retrospective development evidence for v3, never fresh v3 qualification data.
0.10 tolerances and 45/30-second targets are declared next-iteration targets, not observed improvements. Absolute caps and sensor processing must be frozen before qualification.

interpretation: Retrospective diagnosis unless explicit qualification evidence is supplied. Never changes original success verdicts.
